title: nan
authors: Jarraya I.; Alahmed F.; Abdelkader M.; Gabr K.; Kadri M.B.; Boulila W.
key_contribution: Presents CLAK, a CNN-LSTM-Attention-KAN deep learning framework for non-visual UAV localization in GNSS-denied environments using LiDAR, barometric altitude, and IMU, validated in simulation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_LiDAR_Inertial_Fusion to ensure precise positioning.
